identity: University of Amsterdam, Dutch-taught BSc Information Science (Informatiekunde), RIO 56842, source row 420. The dated course guide lists no formal route.
sourceUse: The dated programme guide specifies required, restricted and open groups and credit amounts. The UvA public table and planning PDF corroborate structure but lay out parallel options without the same rule detail. The older reconstruction took two year-three options and omitted the mandatory Reflection on Digital Culture. The authoritative group listing requires that course plus one of Logic and Society or Social Robotics. Year two legitimately selects Regulatory Compliant Information Systems and Semantic Web from three options including Recommender Systems. Neither selection is presented as a prescribed specialisation.
components: Year two requires two of three courses: this course, Semantic Web and Recommender Systems. This example includes the first two named here.
Builds on programming, databases and introductory logic. Basic web development knowledge is recommended.
Builds on descriptive statistics and applies research methods to human-computer interaction.
UvA recommends advanced programming and prior Research Methods for Interactive Systems.
Choose 30 EC in the first semester of year three.
Required in year three alongside the final project and one of two restricted electives.
This example selects Logic and Society. Social Robotics is the other option.
Complete all 60 EC from each of the first two years before starting. The Board of Examiners can grant an individual exemption.

58748.name: Recommender Systems
58748.recommendedPriorKnowledge: Voor dit vak gaan we ervan uit dat je een aantal basisvaardigheden al beheerst. Het vak is bedoeld voor tweedejaars Informatiekunde en bouwt voort op kennis en vaardigheden die je eerder in de opleiding hebt opgedaan. Om dit vak goed te kunnen volgen, is het belangrijk dat je: kunt programmeren in Python; bekend bent met Pandas voor het werken met tabulaire data; weet hoe je met JupyterLab of Jupyter Notebooks werkt; beschikt over basiskennis van statistiek, zoals gemiddelden, variantie en correlatie; kunt rekenen met vectoren, bijvoorbeeld het inproduct; enige ervaring hebt met het lezen, bewerken en analyseren van datasets.

progression.firstYear: The binding study advice requires at least 42 EC by the end of the first year. Programming and logic precede Network Science, and statistics and Python support Information Visualization.
progression.yearsTwoAndThree: For the ordinary cohort, a student who has not completed all first-year credits after two years is blocked from second- and third-year modules until completion. Modern Databases precedes the data-governance project. The illustrated Semantic Web choice draws on prior programming, databases and logic. Interactive Systems Research Methods builds on descriptive statistics and supports the system project alongside advanced programming knowledge.
progression.finalProject: The standard entry requirements are completion of all 60 EC in year one and all 60 EC in year two. The Board of Examiners may grant individual dispensation. The dated entry calls for a supervised individual investigation, implementation or evaluation, written thesis and defence.
